system.description: An eternal crusade across the galaxy, fought by warriors who renew their oaths on the eve of every battle. Their faith is a weapon, and their intolerance of the witch is a hardship they must master to serve in the Deathwatch.

pastEvents.name: Received a Vision
pastEvents.text: On the eve of a great battle, you prayed for guidance from the Emperor and received it. This guidance took the form of a vision, the details of which are known only to you. Afterwards, you helped defeat a powerful enemy and proved the worth of your faith in the Emperor.

pastEvents.name: Established a Keep
pastEvents.text: You lent your assistance to establishing a Chapter keep upon an isolated frontier world as part of the Black Templars' eternal crusade. This grim fortress stands as a monument to your deeds and those of your fighting company.

pastEvents.name: The Geonide Crusade
pastEvents.text: Alongside your fellow Black Templars, you recovered invaluable artefacts from the Adeptus Mechanicus laboratories under siege by rebellious forces on the planet of Geonide. You personally slew a handful of rogue psykers and resisted their unnatural powers.

pastEvents.name: Trained a Neophyte
pastEvents.text: You upheld the traditions of the Black Templars by training and mentoring a young Neophyte through dozens of battles. Some Neophytes do not survive to become full Initiates in the Chapter.

pastEvents.name: Boarding Action
pastEvents.text: The Black Templars are a fleet-based Chapter, and during a tense battle in space, you and a group of your fellow Space Marines launched a boarding action against an enemy ship, destroying it from inside, turning the tide of the battle and preserving the fleet for later crusade.

rules.note: His zygotes are deficient: a Black Templar gains nothing from the Betcher's gland or the sus-an membrane (p. 40).

bonuses.name: Righteous Zeal (Solo Mode)
bonuses.effect: The Chapter's own Solo Mode ability; its text is in the Deathwatch compendium.

bonuses.name: Demeanour: Zealous
bonuses.effect: The beliefs and traditions his Chapter shares, and his to play (p. 32).

system.description: Millennia of victories bought with ferocity at close quarters, and a curse carried in the blood. By day a paragon; by night he fights damnation alone in his cell.

pastEvents.name: Scouring of Ultramar
pastEvents.text: Commander Dante dispatched several squads of Blood Angels, including your own, to assist the Ultramarines in cleansing several worlds of the Tyranid presence of Hive Fleet Behemoth. After three years, you and the other survivors of this mission returned with invaluable experience in fighting this particular xenos threat.

pastEvents.name: Assault on Baal
pastEvents.text: You held the line with the rest of your Battle-Brothers against an Ork invasion of your homeworld, Baal. You were among the reinforcements who successfully defended the Blood Angel fortress-monastery against the greenskin tides.

pastEvents.name: A New Beginning
pastEvents.text: The Blood Angels have had rocky alliances with their successor Chapters. However, you were there to witness a historic event when the Flesh Tearers, a successor Chapter of the Blood Angels, sealed a pact of brotherhood and ended centuries of strife and discord.

pastEvents.name: Golgotha Strike Force
pastEvents.text: You were part of Strike Force Bloodhawk, deployed to the insurrectionist world of Golgotha. Perhaps you were in the armoured columns or amongst the Stormraven gunships that smashed through the outer fortress walls.

pastEvents.name: Purged a Space Hulk
pastEvents.text: In support of Blood Angel Terminators from the First Company, you assisted in the cleansing of a massive space hulk, infested with dangerous xenos lifeforms, Chaos renegades, or worse.

bonuses.name: Blood Frenzy (Solo Mode)
bonuses.effect: The Chapter's own Solo Mode ability; its text is in the Deathwatch compendium.

bonuses.name: Demeanour: The Red Thirst
bonuses.effect: The beliefs and traditions his Chapter shares, and his to play (p. 32).

system.description: The First Legion, keepers of a secret they hunt across the galaxy. Unquestioning loyalty, proven in trials no outsider is told of.

pastEvents.name: Encountered the Fallen
pastEvents.text: You have come face-to-face with, or have had a rare glimpse of, the black-armoured Space Marines who were once your brothers, the Fallen Dark Angels. These renegades are relentlessly hunted by your Chapter, and you have been sworn to secrecy regarding their existence.

pastEvents.name: Served in the Ravenwing
pastEvents.text: You have joined your brothers on many lightning attacks as part of the Ravenwing. Either as gunner on a Land Speeder or an attack bike, your speed and precision against countless enemies of the Imperium is rivalled by few. You may have even been privy to secrets that few even in the Chapter know.

pastEvents.name: Preserved the Secrets of the Chapter
pastEvents.text: Your unquestioning loyalty has been proven in the trials of combat when you were part of a mission of utmost importance, purging heretical records forged by those who would spread vicious lies about the Dark Angels. What secrets you destroyed are a mystery even to you and will remain so for all time.

pastEvents.name: Thunderhawk Gunner
pastEvents.text: You have served your Chapter as the gunner for one of the powerful Thunderhawk gunships. You have a unique perspective on the battlefield, having fought in the air, on the ground, and in space.

pastEvents.name: The Lion and the Wolf
pastEvents.text: While serving alongside the Space Wolves Chapter, you were chosen to fight a ritual duel against one of their members. You claimed distinction with your victory and at least one Space Wolf curses your name under his breath.

bonuses.name: Stoic Defence (Solo Mode)
bonuses.effect: The Chapter's own Solo Mode ability; its text is in the Deathwatch compendium.

bonuses.name: Demeanour: Sons of The Lion
bonuses.effect: The beliefs and traditions his Chapter shares, and his to play (p. 32).

system.description: Ferocious, blunt and honest to a fault, with senses sharper than any other Chapter's. They mark the eve of battle in bawdy celebration rather than prayer.

pastEvents.name: Bitter Vengeance
pastEvents.text: You have fought face-to-face with Chaos Space Marines from the Thousand Sons Legion. These renegades are considered arch-enemies of the Space Wolves, and furious, no-quarter battles erupt whenever they meet.

pastEvents.name: Fenris Hunter
pastEvents.text: You have hunted and slain one of the extremely dangerous creatures native to Fenris. Among these creatures are the mighty kraken, huge ice bears, and the ferocious Fenrisian wolf.

pastEvents.name: Service in the Fleet
pastEvents.text: Most Space Marine Chapters maintain a number of strike cruisers, battle-barges, and smaller craft to support their operations on a planet's surface. Having fought many battles amongst the stars, you may have commanded a rapid strike vessel, or perhaps served as an officer aboard a larger ship.

pastEvents.name: Wolf-Tamer
pastEvents.text: Fenrisian Wolves have a unique bond with the Space Wolves Chapter, and often fought beside them. At one time, you had tamed such a powerful beast as a trusted battle companion. He may survive still back on Fenris, or he may have fallen to the weapons of the enemy in some previous combat.

pastEvents.name: The Great Hunt
pastEvents.text: Many times, Space Wolves have left Fenris to sail upon the sea of stars, seeking out any sign of their long-vanished Primarch Leman Russ. These Great Hunts have not yet succeeded in locating the primarch, but often carve new legends of heroism from across the galaxy. You have been fortunate enough to have taken part in a Great Hunt.

bonuses.name: Wolf Senses (Solo Mode)
bonuses.effect: The Chapter's own Solo Mode ability; its text is in the Deathwatch compendium.

bonuses.name: Demeanour: The Sons of Russ
bonuses.effect: The beliefs and traditions his Chapter shares, and his to play (p. 32).

system.description: Clannish, honourable and fond of debate, the Storm Wardens fight with keen fervour and seek out an enemy champion to test themselves against. Their curiosity about mysteries brings many of them to the Deathwatch.

pastEvents.name: Sole Survivor
pastEvents.text: The Space Marines are mighty warriors, but they are not invincible. You learned this bitter lesson first-hand, as you are the only survivor of your squad, having encountered a particularly dangerous enemy; perhaps a Tyranid Hive Tyrant or Chaos daemon prince.

pastEvents.name: Tank Gunner
pastEvents.text: You have served your Chapter as the gunner in one of the Chapter's armoured vehicles, perhaps a Predator or Land Raider. You have fought in the vanguard of several armoured assaults, and the machine-spirits of such vehicles are well-known to you.

pastEvents.name: Service in the Fleet
pastEvents.text: Most Space Marine Chapters maintain a number of strike cruisers, battle-barges, and smaller craft to support their operations on a planet's surface. Having fought many battles amongst the stars, you may have commanded a rapid strike vessel, or perhaps served as an officer aboard a larger ship.

pastEvents.name: The Scouring of Vigil
pastEvents.text: You bear the deep scars of the campaign upon Vigil against the foul alien Slaugth. These xenos maggot-men and their slave-constructs were defeated in a long series of savage close-quarter battles in the tunnels beneath Vigil.

pastEvents.name: Honour Preserved
pastEvents.text: You have aided a fellow brother of your Chapter in preserving his honour. Be it a promise he made that became complicated by fortune or simply a sequence of events that could have gone awry, you are well known within your Chapter as a brother who respects his own honour as well as that of others.

choices.label: Keep the combat knife or take a Sacris claymore (p. 170)

bonuses.name: Thunder's Call (Solo Mode)
bonuses.effect: The Chapter's own Solo Mode ability; its text is in the Deathwatch compendium.

bonuses.name: Demeanour: Aspire to Glory
bonuses.effect: The beliefs and traditions his Chapter shares, and his to play (p. 32).

system.description: The standard against which all Space Marines are measured: thorough, analytical, slow to anger. A high proportion of Deathwatch leaders are drawn from their ranks.

characteristicChoices.label: +5 to two Characteristics of the player's choice

pastEvents.name: Tyrannic War Veteran
pastEvents.text: You fought in the Battle for Macragge, struggling against horrid Tyranid beasts from Hive Fleet Behemoth. Thanks in part to your efforts, the Ultramarines prevailed at great cost.

pastEvents.name: Cleansed Thrax
pastEvents.text: You helped defeat countless daemons on the Chaos-corrupted Forge World of Thrax. Chapter Master Marneus Calgar issued the order for Exterminatus upon the mission's completion.

pastEvents.name: Endured the Waaagh!
pastEvents.text: You stood with your fellow Ultramarines against Waaagh! Gutshredda in the Forgoil system. Dozens of greenskin invaders died at your hands.

pastEvents.name: Banner Bearer
pastEvents.text: You were once chosen to carry a standard, possibly a back banner for your squad or even the prestigious company banner. This selection was a great honour, and one not easily relinquished until you joined the Deathwatch.

pastEvents.name: Scout Sergeant
pastEvents.text: For a time, you led a Scout squad in the Ultramarines Tenth Company. During this time, you mentored many young Scouts on their way to becoming full Battle-Brothers.

bonuses.name: Favoured Son (Solo Mode)
bonuses.effect: The Chapter's own Solo Mode ability; its text is in the Deathwatch compendium.

bonuses.name: Demeanour: Honour the Codex
bonuses.effect: The beliefs and traditions his Chapter shares, and his to play (p. 32).
